channel.title: AI GridWatch — Kentucky data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Kentucky, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Louisville: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 6-month moratorium passed by Metro Council. Advanced by P&Z Committee 7-1 on Aug 4. Originally proposed Sep 2025 after a 1.6M sq ft hyperscale was approved with little public input

item.title: Bell County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium, unanimous. Halts Murray Industries' hyperscale project on former coal mining land along Bell-Knox county line. Murray had already begun clearing land before the vote

item.title: Daviess County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, unanimous. Triggered by hyperscale data center planned at idled aluminum mill in neighboring Hancock County

item.title: Cave City: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium, 4-1. Under legal challenge — Kentucky Industrial Alliance (proposed 1.2 GW 'Cave Point Commerce Center' on ~600 acres) filed suit Jun 8

item.title: Lexington (Fayette County): data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium on permits, development plans, and zone changes, unanimous. Expires Oct 31; Planning Division drafting Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment proposals

item.title: Allen County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium (Ord. 26-03). Proactive — Judge-Executive observed 'headaches' in nearby Simpson County with hyperscale proposal

item.title: Mercer County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium in unincorporated areas, unanimous. Does NOT apply to City of Burgin, which is pursuing annexation to accommodate a proposed hyperscale data center. Grassroots group 'We Are Mercer County' active

item.title: Jessamine County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium. Proactive — no data center development inquiries had been made in the county at time of vote

item.title: Cave City: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on new data centers, approved 4-1 on second reading to allow time to draft zoning language; the city was subsequently sued over the moratorium and has asked for the suit's dismissal.

item.title: Bell County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year moratorium, passed unanimously by the fiscal court; halted a Murray Industries hyperscale project that had already begun clearing land along the Bell-Knox county line

item.title: London: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 2-year pause passed 5-1, running to Sep 30, 2028 and extendable a further year by council

item.title: Logan County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month pause in unincorporated areas, adopted specifically to study local water supply capacity against high-consumption users
